source.coordinate_convention: origin top-left; x right; y down
source.method: Manual roof-edge traces against the native south AECOM image, checked against the calibrated R2_south camera by inverse projection onto Z=26.2 m. Polygons describe visible roof extents; hidden abutments remain inferred.

current_spec_comparison.y_198: Not supported by the B6 roof trace as a south-view position; the north-derived wing crossing remains a cross-view registration/source-interpretation conflict.
current_spec_comparison.y_73: No distinct covered roof is resolved in B6 at this position; likely a north-view registration or duplicate interpretation of the upper/middle link.
current_spec_comparison.y_minus_48: Supported by the middle B6 covered link and its south-side low-wing landing.
current_spec_comparison.y_minus_113: Supported by the farthest-south B6 covered link and its southern west-side landing.

south_count_conclusion.confidence: medium-high for count and ordering; medium for exact hidden abutments and world-Y reconciliation between north and south cameras

covered_bridges.name: south_view_upper_medical_link
covered_bridges.landing_evidence: West roof trace enters the medical/rail-side building zone; east end is partly occluded by the stadium-side low mass.

covered_bridges.name: south_view_medical_wing_link
covered_bridges.landing_evidence: The east roof edge terminates at the stadium-side concourse; the west edge is tied to the low medical wing/courtyard sequence rather than open ground.

covered_bridges.name: south_view_southern_district_link
covered_bridges.landing_evidence: The west end aligns with the southern courtyard/building cluster; the east end enters the stadium forecourt.
covered_bridges.confidence: high for visible roof span; medium for hidden west landing

adjacent_west_footprints.name: south_low_medical_wing
adjacent_west_footprints.landing_relation: Receives the west side of the y≈−48 medical-wing link; its south edge also frames the rail-side concourse below the upper link.
adjacent_west_footprints.confidence: medium; upper/north edge is partly occluded by taller medical mass

adjacent_west_footprints.name: southern_west_courtyard_block
adjacent_west_footprints.landing_relation: Large roof-courtyard block immediately west/southwest of the y≈−113 link; retain the open central courtyard and do not close it with a solid roof polygon.
adjacent_west_footprints.confidence: high for outer roof silhouette and courtyard void; medium for occluded southwest corner

adjacent_west_footprints.name: southern_west_red_low_wing
adjacent_west_footprints.landing_relation: Lower red-brick bar south of the courtyard block; use as the secondary west landing/concourse mass if the south district crossing needs a buried approach volume.
adjacent_west_footprints.confidence: medium; footprint is source-visible but its ownership/name is not resolved by the artwork

height_basis: Covered-crossing deck and roof use the existing private-link prior deck_z=22.0 m and roof_z=26.2 m. Low west-side building roof/base values are inferred from the south image and existing medical building priors, not surveyed dimensions.
